data.body:
## LANDED — Gerrit change 1470 is MERGED (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1)

https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1470 -> status MERGED, on origin/main as
`bfdb68070a 2a76: surface a rejected tickets push`. Submit requirements: Verified SATISFIED,
LLM-Review SATISFIED, 0 unresolved comments.

## AC disposition

- [x] **a rejected auto-push is surfaced to the writing caller rather than failing silently** --
      the warning now names the git rejection reason (the GH013 block, the offending commit and
      path, the `! [remote rejected] ... (pre-receive hook declined)` line) AND an escalating
      `(N unpushed commits on <remote>/<branch>..HEAD)` backlog. Replicated end-to-end through
      the real CLI: before/after transcript in the Phase 2 report comment.
- [x] **a test drives a REJECTED push and asserts the caller sees it (not a mock call count)** --
      `tests/unit/test_push_rejection_surfacing.py`: a real local bare origin whose real
      `pre-receive` hook declines; remote hits counted from the SERVER side via the hook's own
      log. Proven RED first, held out from the implementing subagent (the file was moved out of
      its working tree), GREEN on re-application, and returned to RED by re-seeding the exact
      root cause.
- [x] **a policy rejection is not retried three times as if it were a non-fast-forward** --
      measured 3 remote hits before, 1 after.
- [x] **the best-effort contract is preserved** -- `push_tickets_branch` still returns None,
      never raises, HEAD unmoved, local commit intact; regression-asserted.
- [x] **a recorded decision on scanning ticket event payloads for secrets on write** -- the
      decision EXISTS and is durable: **YES, scan on write**, at the single choke point every
      writer shares (`src/rebar/_commands/_seam.py:349` `append_event`), rejecting/redacting
      high-confidence credential patterns BEFORE the event file is written, with regression
      fixtures so placeholder forms do not fire. Recorded in [rebar:e7a9-35fa-1d58-4095], and
      already accepted as satisfying the identical AC on [rebar:94d0-5d19-2d06-4fa7] at its close.
      This AC asked for a recorded DECISION, not the implementation.

      **What is NOT done, and is not this ticket's to do:** the IMPLEMENTATION of the screen, and
      the still-open **refuse vs redact** sub-decision, both live in e7a9 (open, P2). e7a9's own
      decision-material comment measured the false-positive population and found the fact that
      should drive that ruling -- of five `sk-ant-api03` matches across 3,299 ticket dirs, ZERO
      are credentials and TWO are e7a9's own CREATE and EDIT events, so a naive refuse-on-write
      screen would have refused the creation of the ticket that specifies it.

## Carried forward, not dropped

[rebar:e1ed-b700-c442-4d0c] (P2, filed and linked `discovered_from` this ticket) owns RC-3: the
surfaces where a failed push is UNDELIVERABLE rather than merely uninformative -- the `async`
policy (detached `Popen` with `stderr=DEVNULL`; MEASURED exit 0 / stderr EMPTY), library
embedders (`NullHandler`), the MCP tool result (no push field), and the reconciler subprocess
(handler installed on the wrong logger root). This change does NOT help those paths, and anyone
running `sync.push=async` should know a rejection remains invisible there until e1ed lands.

Closing: all five ACs dispositioned, the change is merged and Verified +1.
